newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman bourse steams ahead on back of banking sector.
newsitem.headline: Oman bourse steams ahead on back of banking sector.

text.p: The Oman stock exchange index continued to make strong gains in the week to Wednesday, reaching a new high of 313.19 points from 296.72 the previous week, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The total value of trade soared to 41.1 million rials ($109 million) from 26.1 million last week.
Turnover rose slightly to 11.81 million shares from 7.8 million the previous week.
The exchange said the banking and investment sector accounted for 81 percent of trade.
Among the most active stocks was the National Bank of Oman with 561,000 shares worth 3.81 million rials changing hands. The stock closed at seven rials from 6.750 rials the previous week.
Al Ahlia Portfolio Securities was also active, with 367,000 shares worth 3.65 million rials traded. The stock closed at 10.080 rials from 8.700 a week earlier.
Oman Flour Mills rose 0.450 rials to 4.350. Oman National Holding Co closed 0.300 rials higher at 5.800.
Some 79 stocks were traded in the week, of which 49 rose, 13 dipped and 17 were unchanged. ($1=0.377 rials)
